licence: U.S. government work; NOAA asks for attribution
attribution: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, Storm Events Database
known_biases: Reports follow people and roads: an empty cell may be unobserved, not calm.
Coverage by type changed: tornado only 1950-54; tornado, thunderstorm wind and hail 1955-95; all event types from 1996.
Hail size and wind speed are mostly estimates by the public and spotters (see `source` and `wind_measure`); sizes cluster on familiar objects (1.00, 1.75 inches).
Before the mid-1990s most events carry county or zone locations, not points.
Times are NCEI local standard time converted with the zone's standard offset; daylight saving is not applied by NCEI's files, so summer times may be one hour off true local time.
Damage figures are NWS estimates in the dollars of the event year, parsed from K/M/B strings.
NCEI re-creates yearly files in place; the snapshot manifest (SHA-256 per file) pins what this table was built from.
